Problem\u003c/p>\u003ch2>Useful opportunities are spread across too many places.\u003c/h2>\u003cp>Finding scholarships, grants, and other funding can be frustrating. Information is scattered across different websites, while some scholarship-search sites feel cluttered, repetitive, or spammy.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003carticle>\u003cp class=\"label\">What We're Building\u003c/p>\u003ch2>A more student-friendly way to look.\u003c/h2>\u003cp>The team will explore a centralized digital tool or database that makes opportunities easier to discover and understand. This is not meant to be another giant list: students will help decide how information should be researched, organized, presented, and eventually accessed.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003c/div>\u003c/section>\n      \u003csection class=\"section cream\">\u003cdiv class=\"section-inner\">\u003cp class=\"label\">What Students Would Actually Do\u003c/p>\u003ch2 class=\"section-title\">Three areas, working together.\u003c/h2>\u003cp class=\"lead-block\">Research provides useful information. Design determines how students interact with it. Development turns the experience into something functional.\u003c/p>\u003cdiv class=\"project-contribution-grid\">\u003carticle class=\"ruled\">\u003cp class=\"number\">01\u003c/p>\u003ch3>Tech / Development\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Help turn the concept into a functioning digital experience. Work could include developing or improving the interface, organizing how opportunity information is handled, connecting parts of the experience, testing functionality, and fixing technical or usability problems.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003carticle class=\"ruled\">\u003cp class=\"number\">02\u003c/p>\u003ch3>Research &amp; Data\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Research scholarships, grants, and funding from reliable sources. Organize information consistently; check eligibility, deadlines when available, and official application links; and identify what students need when comparing opportunities.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003carticle class=\"ruled\">\u003cp class=\"number\">03\u003c/p>\u003ch3>UI / UX Design\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Decide how opportunities should be displayed, organize information visually, design screens and layouts, improve mobile usability, and test whether the experience is clear and intuitive.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003c/div>\u003c/div>\u003c/section>\n      \u003csection class=\"section warm project-goal\">\u003cdiv class=\"section-inner split-grid\">\u003cdiv>\u003cp class=\"label\">Project Goal\u003c/p>\u003ch2 class=\"section-title\">Work toward a useful first version.\u003c/h2>\u003c/div>\u003cp class=\"lead-block\">By the end of the sprint, the team should be working toward a usable version that demonstrates how FYM can make scholarship and funding discovery simpler and more student-friendly.\u003c/p>\u003c/div>\u003c/section>\n      \u003csection class=\"section warm\">\u003cdiv class=\"section-inner\">\u003cp class=\"label\">Six-Week Execution Sprint\u003c/p>\u003ch2 class=\"section-title\">A framework for making something tangible.\u003c/h2>\u003cp class=\"lead-block\">The sprint keeps the team focused on one shared outcome rather than disconnected club assignments.\u003c/p>\u003cdiv class=\"sprint-timeline detailed\">\u003carticle>\u003cspan>Week 1\u003c/span>\u003ch3>Research &amp; Understand\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Study existing resources and determine what information students actually need.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003carticle>\u003cspan>Week 2\u003c/span>\u003ch3>Plan\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Define the first version, organize the information, and divide responsibilities.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003carticle>\u003cspan>Week 3\u003c/span>\u003ch3>Build\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Move research, design, and development from planning into execution.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003carticle>\u003cspan>Week 4\u003c/span>\u003ch3>Test\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Use the work as a student would and find confusing, missing, or broken pieces.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003carticle>\u003cspan>Week 5\u003c/span>\u003ch3>Improve\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Use feedback to strengthen the parts that matter most.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003carticle>\u003cspan>Week 6\u003c/span>\u003ch3>Finish &amp; Publish\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Bring the work into a version that can be shared, demonstrated, or published.\u003c/p>\u003c/article>\u003c/div>\u003c/div>\u003c/section>\n      \u003csection class=\"section blue with-lead\">\u003cdiv class=\"section-inner split-grid\">\u003cdiv>\u003cp let route = '/';
const app = document.getElementById('app');
function show(next) {
  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(bundle.pages, next)) return;
  route = next;
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(bundle.pages[route], 'text/html');
  doc.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(el => el.remove());
  document.getElementById('fym-style').textContent = bundle.css;
  document.title = doc.title;
  app.replaceChildren(...doc.body.childNodes);
  const reportHeight = () => parent.postMessage({type:'fym:height', route, height:Math.max(document.body.scrollHeight, document.documentElement.scrollHeight)}, '*');
  app.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(a => {
    const url = new URL(a.getAttribute('href'), 'https://fym.invalid' + route);
    if (url.origin === 'https://fym.invalid' && bundle.pages[url.pathname]) {
      a.href = '#' + url.pathname;
      a.addEventListener('click', event => {
        if (event.button !== 0 || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) return;
        event.preventDefault(); parent.postMessage({type:'fym:navigate', route:url.pathname}, '*'); show(url.pathname);
      });
    } else { a.href = url.href; a.target = '_blank'; a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'; }
  });
  app.querySelectorAll('[data-project-apply]').forEach(link => {
    const destination = bundle.config && bundle.config.projectApplicationUrl;
    if (destination) {
      link.href = destination;
      link.target = '_blank';
      link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    } else {
      link.removeAttribute('href');
      link.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
      link.classList.add('button-disabled');
      link.title = 'Applications will open when the official form is ready.';
    }
  });
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  requestAnimationFrame(reportHeight);
  setTimeout(reportHeight, 250);
  Promise.all(Array.from(app.images).map(img => img.complete ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise(resolve => {img.addEventListener('load', resolve, {once:true}); img.addEventListener('error', resolve, {once:true});}))).then(reportHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('message', event => {
  if (event.source !== parent || !event.data) return;
  if (event.data.type === 'fym:render') {
    if (!event.data.pages || typeof event.data.css !== 'string') return;
    bundle = event.data; show(bundle.route || '/');
  }
});
show('/');
parent.postMessage({type:'fym:ready'}, '*');
</script></body></html>
